What are the 7 steps of the Fetch-Decode-Execute Cycle?
back: 1. Fetch Instruction 2. Increment PC 3. Decode Instruction 4. Fetch operand if necessary 5. Execute ALU or control logic 6. Store in register or RAM 7. Repeat
